## Changes

Describe the final scope and purpose, including any work added after opening the PR. Link learning notes when relevant.

## Validation

List commands and outcomes, automated test counts, and any manual verification.

## Limitations

Record untested behavior or remaining issues.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Commit subjects are specific, complete, and focused.
- [ ] Every changed Cargo package has a valid source target; all its targets compile.
- [ ] Incomplete snippets are in Markdown notes; new notes are readable in a diff.
- [ ] Title and description cover the full diff against the destination branch.
- [ ] Verification claims match actual results, and untested work is identified.
- [ ] Staged changes and PR files have been reviewed for accidental files.
